evidence.title: GitHub - Aslam97/react-confirm-dialog: React Confirm Dialog · GitHub

name: React Confirm Dialog
summary: Promise-based confirm dialog for React, built on Radix Alert Dialog and styled with Tailwind CSS v4.
description: A confirm dialog component for React with a useConfirm hook whose promise resolves to true or false. Built on Radix UI Alert Dialog with Tailwind CSS v4 styling; supports icons, custom button props, content slots and custom actions. Ships ESM and CommonJS builds with TypeScript types for React 18 and 19; installed from npm as @omit/react-confirm-dialog.
contains: Radix UI Alert Dialog base, Tailwind CSS v4
custom buttons, icons, content slots and actions
React 18 and 19; ESM and CommonJS builds with types
